summary.headline: Planetary Parts and Blindness Degrees
summary.text: Astrological tables assign the twelve and nine planetary parts across the zodiac signs, with degree and minute columns and repeated allocations involving the Sun, Mars, Venus, and Mercury. A separate table gives degrees associated with blindness.
